results.question: How much is deducted for a prepaid return shipping label if I return an item because I changed my mind?

results.question: What is the cost of standard shipping and what is the free shipping threshold?

results.question: How long do I have to cancel an order after placing it on the website?
results.answer:
According to [1] Order Cancellation Policy - Self-Service Cancellation Window (Page 1, 30-Minute Cancellation Grace Period):
Customers have a 30-minute self-service grace period immediately after order submission to cancel an order directly from their account dashboard by navigating to 'My Orders' and clicking 'Cancel Order'. During this 30-minute window, a full refund is immediately credited back to the original payment method without processing deductions. Once the 30-minute window expires, orders are locked and transmitted to the automated warehouse sorting lines and cannot be cancelled or intercepted.

results.question: Can customer support change my delivery address after my order moves to processing?
results.answer:

Customer support cannot manually adjust shipping destinations once an order has progressed to 'Processing' or 'Dispatched'. If your order has already shipped, you cannot cancel it mid-transit; you should wait for the package to arrive, refuse the parcel at delivery, or generate a free prepaid return label in your account portal once it is delivered.

results.question: Within what timeframe must damaged or defective deliveries be reported?
results.answer:

If your order arrives damaged, shattered, or defective, you must report the issue within 48 hours of delivery confirmation. Contact customer support via our portal or live chat with your order number, a clear photograph showing the shipping carton and damaged item, and a description of the defect. We will immediately ship an expedited replacement at zero cost or issue a 100% full refund including all original shipping fees. You are not required to return shattered or hazardous broken goods unless requested for safety inspection.

results.question: What should I do if a carrier marks my parcel as delivered but it is not at my door?
results.answer:
According to [1] Missing Items and Lost Packages - Investigation Process (Page 1, Missing Items & Marked Delivered But Not Received):
If tracking indicates your package was 'Delivered' but you cannot find it, please check side porches, building reception desks, and check with household members. Carriers occasionally scan packages up to 24 hours prior to actual drop-off. If the package has still not appeared after 24 hours of delivery status (and within 7 days of the scan), submit a 'Lost Parcel Claim' in our help center. NovaCart will initiate a carrier trace; if unresolved within 48 hours, we will either resend your order via priority courier or issue a complete refund.

results.question: How long is a password reset verification code valid?
results.answer:
